bias_targets.methodology: Measuring discretion arbitrariness and principle supremacy (prioritization) by comparing human preference labels in safety datasets (HH-RLHF, PKU-SafeRLHF) against 21 explicit Constitutional AI principles evaluated by a zero-shot LLM oracle.

Calculating discretion discrepancy and principle prioritization of reward models and off-the-shelf LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek-V3) to evaluate how their automated preference judgments deviate from human annotators and established normative principles.
